evidence.description: The report's selected result states the test was run on 24 mesocosm-level values with one analysed value per mesocosm, and the reported U = 141.0 is only attainable on a 12-vs-12 comparison (maximum U = 144). Independent recomputation of the seasonal means from data/input.csv gives exactly three warmed-ambient inversions (ambient M12 mean 3.35 exceeds warmed M13 2.95, M14 3.10, M15 3.22), reproducing U = 144 - 3 = 141; a row-level 48-vs-48 test would produce U on a scale up to 2304.
evidence.observed_value: U = 141.0, p = 5.177e-06 on n = 12 + 12 mesocosm means; recomputed U = 141 matches

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Exact two-sided Mann-Whitney U test on 24 mesocosm-level mean CH4 fluxes (12 warmed vs 12 ambient, one analysed value per mesocosm): U = 141.0, p = 5.177e-06; warmed mesocosms released more methane (median mesocosm mean 3.82 vs 1.97 mg CH4 per square metre per hour).

The four campaign records of a mesocosm are repeated measurements of the same randomised
unit, so they were averaged before any test was run. Collapsing the long-format file gives
24 mesocosm mean CH4 fluxes, exactly one per mesocosm, so no mesocosm contributes more
than one value. The 12 warmed mesocosm means were then compared with the 12 ambient
mesocosm means using a two-sided exact Mann-Whitney U test.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to show that the test was actually run on the 96 campaign rows despite the report's claims. Tracing the code, mannwhitneyu receives the outputs of group_means, which iterates over the collapsed OrderedDict keyed by mesocosm_id (24 entries), so the test inputs cannot contain more than one value per mesocosm; the code also raises on inconsistent treatment labels or unbalanced campaign counts. As a numerical check independent of the code's claims, I recomputed all 24 seasonal means from data/input.csv by hand and counted warmed-ambient pair inversions: ambient M12 (mean 3.35) exceeds warmed M13 (2.95), M14 (3.10) and M15 (3.22), and no other inversions exist, giving U = 12*12 - 3 = 141, exactly matching the reported U = 141.0. A row-level 48-vs-48 test would yield U on a 0-2304 scale, so the reported statistic is inconsistent with a row-level analysis. The falsification attempt failed; the analysis is genuinely mesocosm-level.
